title: Bacterial Cultivation Protocol for Nasal and Throat Samples
author: Dina Stensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2j6gcre

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Labeling
steps.instruction: Sort samples by testnumber and separate nasal swabs from throat swabs.

substeps.instruction: Label enrichment broths with identical testnumbers.
Assign nasal swab 1 and throat swab 1 for cultivation.
Freeze nasal swab 2 and throat swab 2 for microbiome analysis.

steps.title: Inoculate Enrichment Broth
steps.instruction: Inoculate the enrichment broth within a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Open the Copan medium.
Place the rayon-tipped swab into the broth.
Rotate the swab sample for approximately 1 second.
Seal the enrichment broth with a plastic cork.

steps.title: Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the enrichment broths for 18-24 hours at 37 degrees Celsius.

steps.title: Prepare Agar Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare blood, SAID, and MRSA plates for participants and controls.

substeps.instruction: For each participant: Use one blood plate, one SAID-plate, and one MRSA-plate.
Mark participant plates with testnumber and a vertical pencil stroke to divide the plate into two equal parts.
Label the left side 'n' (Nasal swab) and the right side 'T' (throat swab).
Prepare one blood plate, one SAID-plate, and one MRSA-plate for controls, marking them as 'control'.

steps.title: Plate Inoculation
steps.instruction: Inoculate the prepared plates in a fume hood using the enrichment broths.

substeps.instruction: Mix the enrichment broth using a Pasteur pipette.
Place 1 drop of nasal swab enrichment broth on the left side ('n') of the associated plates and spread with an inoculating loop.
Place 1 drop of throat swab enrichment broth on the right side ('T') of the associated plates and spread with an inoculating loop.
Repeat the procedure for control plates, using the whole plate instead of splitting it.

steps.title: Primary Plate Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate participant and control plates at 37 degrees Celsius until the next day.

steps.title: Growth Identification
steps.instruction: Identify growth on all plates and record results in tables.

substeps.instruction: Assign 1 for growth and 0 for no growth.
Verify that growth on SAID and MRSA plates is pink.

steps.title: Subculture Pink Colonies
steps.instruction: If pink colonies grow on SAID or MRSA plates, subculture the most dominating colonies.

substeps.instruction: Pick the most dominating colony from both the left (nasal) and right (throat) sides.
Prepare a blood plate marked with the testnumber and a vertical pencil stroke dividing it into 'N' (Nasal) and 'T' (throat).
Spread the dominating colonies onto their associating sides of the plate.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the remaining tests at 37 degrees Celsius for 20-24 hours.

steps.title: S. aureus Verification
steps.instruction: Verify the presence of Staphylococcus aureus on the blood plates using the Staphaurex plus agglutination test.

substeps.instruction: Record results in tables as K+ (koagulase positive) or K- (koagulase negative).
Define koagulase positive as growth of Staphylococcus aureus.

steps.title: Isolate Storage
steps.instruction: Freeze confirmed Staphylococcus aureus isolates at -70 degrees Celsius in glycerol-containing liquid media for molecular analysis.
